title: Avalanche incidents
reason: No source with terms that clearly permit republishing incident locations was found (2026-11-06). CAIC terms prohibit robots and data mining and reserve reproduction to prior written permission; avalanche.org asks API users to seek permission. See official-links.json and docs/methods/snow-sar-incidents.md.
limitations: Reported accidents only. Missing incidents never imply low risk, and the map never shows a hazard rating.
A point is shown only where the source published coordinates; position.meaning says what it marks (often unknown).
Preliminary reports can change; the official report page is authoritative.
